exposure: Patient and Public Involvement (PPI) in pharmacoepidemiology (PE) research
outcome: Prevalence of PPI mention in published PE studies
PPI experience of French PE research teams
cohort: The study included published pharmacoepidemiology studies (for systematic review) and French pharmacoepidemiology research teams (for cross-sectional survey).
finding: The environmental scan revealed that Patient and Public Involvement (PPI) is an emerging and relevant area in pharmacoepidemiology (PE) studies, although its implementation is still uncommon, necessitating tools to help PE researchers engage in PPIs.
country: France (for cross-sectional study); global literature (for systematic review)
cross-section timing: Interviews conducted in parallel with literature review ending June 30, 2023
